topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Hey, I just heard what's been going on with you and the plagiarism thing. I can’t even imagine how overwhelming this must be. But listen, I believe in you. I know you put your heart and soul into your work. We need to sit down, go through everything, and figure out how to set the record straight. It’s going to be okay. Let’s get through this together, okay? Just reach out whenever you’re ready to talk more. You’re not alone in this.
